Vulnerabilities.Title: libwebp: heap buffer overflow in WebP lossless format
Vulnerabilities.Description: A heap buffer overflow in the WebP image format allows arbitrary code execution.

Vulnerabilities.Title: zlib: heap-based buffer over-read/overflow in inflate()
Vulnerabilities.Description: zlib before 1.2.12 has a heap-based buffer over-read or overflow via a large gzip header.

Vulnerabilities.Title: glibc: off-by-one buffer overflow/underflow in getcwd()
Vulnerabilities.Description: An off-by-one buffer overflow/underflow in glibc's getcwd() function.

Vulnerabilities.Title: bluez: stack-based buffer overflow in the SDP
Vulnerabilities.Description: A stack-based buffer overflow was found in BlueZ. No fix available for this base image yet.

Vulnerabilities.Title: requests: proxy-authorization header leak
Vulnerabilities.Description: requests before 2.31.0 leaks Proxy-Authorization headers on redirect.
